description: This Java class defines a request to enable network join functionality in a Zigbee simulation environment. It extends a base Request class and interacts with the MockZigbeeCore singleton to trigger network enabling for a specified duration.

classes.name: NetworkEnableJoinRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to enable joining of devices onto the network for a specified duration.

methods.name: NetworkEnableJoinRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request with an ID and the duration in seconds for the network to remain open for joining.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the request by sending a response and invoking the mock Zigbee core to enable network joining for the specified duration.
